trigger_condition.memory_trigger: out tensor aliases one of the input tensors
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.mm called with out= aliasing an input tensor
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: On CPU, pass an out tensor to torch.mm that is the same tensor as, or an overlapping view of, one of the input matrices.

bug_oracle.description: The result produced by torch.mm with out= aliasing an input differs from a non-aliased reference torch.mm result.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Change the out argument to alias one of the input tensors.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Build CPU float tensors with dimensions that allow the output shape to match an input shape, such as square matrices.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Pass an input tensor directly as out= or construct a view with overlapping storage for the output.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.mm(a, b, out=aliased_out) and call torch.mm(a, b) into a fresh output as reference.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare the aliased out result against the fresh reference result; flag any mismatch as incorrect output.
